idea: A function count_vowels(text) that returns how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, in either case) the text contains.

checks.description: Basic case: counts vowels mixed with consonants
Case insensitivity: uppercase and lowercase vowels counted equally
Text with special characters and numbers ignores non-vowels
String of only vowels counts all

tasks.brief: Create module vowels.py with function count_vowels(text) that takes a string and returns an integer count of all vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in either lowercase or uppercase. The function should ignore consonants, numbers, special characters, and whitespace.
